scientific_findings: DIALECT_VARIANCE_REDUCTION: Utterance-level FiLM dialect conditioning successfully reduced cross-accent variance by 20.0% relative (sigma_L1 from 0.0725 to 0.0580), with Vietnamese reaching Macro AP=0.7078 and Macro F1=0.6769.

LOCAL_VS_GLOBAL_TRADEOFF: While FiLM stabilizes cross-accent consistency across cohorts, local unmodulated 5ms monotonic attention (HRTD-Net EXP-48) remains more accurate on individual speakers by avoiding utterance-summary noise.
